# Greenscape
> Production Greenscape System

## Overview
Autonomous application scaffolded from green-horizon.

## Architecture & Features
- **High Performance**: Optimized responsive layout with zero blocking resources.
- **Security Hardened**: OWASP top 10 compliant with strict Content Security Policies.
- **AEO Optimized**: Schema.org JSON-LD graph and llms.txt Answer Engine discovery.
